_comment: Store master data for the ai_garbage_detection import CSV (backend/services/garbage_export.py). One entry per store. storeKey = the S3 folder name the importer uses as the store key; storeName = the store name written in every row; cart_id = whole number (CONFIRM its meaning and source with the importer owner); camera_ids = every camera of that store, exactly as entered in the app. Placeholder values (REPLACE_...) and a null cart_id are rejected on purpose: nothing is exported until real values are filled in. Check with: py -m backend.services.garbage_export check-config
